segment.source: Raised when the effective column assignment of children changes, dispatched after the layout pass.
segment.target: 当子项有效列分配变化时触发，延迟到布局周期结束后派发。

segment.target: 基础用法展示。通过 ColumnCount 设置列数，ColumnGap 和 RowGap 设置间距。

segment.source: Demonstrate dynamic item updates and explicit Masonry.Column assignments.
segment.target: 展示瀑布流子项的动态增删和显式 Masonry.Column 列分配。

segment.source: With StableColumns, images update size and vertical positions as they load without moving existing items between columns.
segment.target: 在 StableColumns 策略下，图片加载时会更新尺寸和纵向位置，但现有项不会在列之间移动。

segment.source: Masonry uses stable column assignments by default and can opt into classic shortest-column reflow, with fixed or adaptive column counts and row/column gaps.
segment.target: Masonry 默认保持已分配列，也可选择经典最短列重排，并支持固定或自适应列数以及行列间距。

segment.source: Lay out children of unequal heights into stable or reflowing columns.
segment.target: 将不同高度的子项排列为稳定列或动态重排列。

segment.source: Use responsive values to adapt to different screen widths. ColumnInfo controls the column count at each breakpoint, and Gutter controls the spacing.
segment.target: 使用响应式参数来适配不同屏幕宽度。ColumnInfo 可以设置在不同断点下的列数，Gutter 可以设置不同断点下的间距大小。
